title: User creates password during registration
gherkin:
Feature: Password Policy Enforcement - Registration
  Scenario: User must create a password during registration
    Given a new user is on the registration page
    When the user attempts to complete registration without providing a password
    Then the system shall reject the registration
    And the system shall display an error message indicating password is required
    When the user provides a valid password
    And the user completes registration
    Then the registration shall succeed
    And the user account shall be created with the provided password
rationale: Validates that the system enforces password creation as a mandatory step during user registration, establishing the baseline password policy requirement at account creation.
usedContextItems: The system shall require the user to create a password during registration
